headline: Mexico consolidates as auto parts supplier to the US
summary: Through September, 45% of auto parts purchased by the United States from abroad came from Mexico, one point more than in 2025, according to INA. Mexico is consolidating its position as a supplier to the US.
why: Mexico is a major auto parts exporter to the United States under North American trade rules, making its supplier position important for the automotive supply chain.
original_headline: México se consolida en proveeduría de autopartes a EU
